title: 7S.2c borrowed group-310 hex and direct byte decode
scope: Avoid owned hex-string copies and decoded staging buffers for DXF group-310 raw proxy/ACIS data
Preserve existing byte ordering, chunk lengths/offsets, and resource admission
Keep append and chunk publication rollback-safe

localSource.finding: Group-310 raw consumers previously materialized getString() output and staged decoded bytes in a second string/vector before copying into the final payload. Binary readers already expose a canonical hex spelling in the current strData record.

production: The common proxy-graphics path borrows getStringView() and decodes directly into proxyGraphics.
ModelerGeometry and SURFACE group-310 paths borrow getStringView() and decode directly into their final payload vectors.
Added a vector append overload for direct hex-to-byte decoding with size checks, one destination reserve, and rollback on malformed input or unexpected exceptions.

Updated the string append helper to decode directly into its destination with rollback; ACIS payload paths reserve chunk metadata before appending and restore the previous payload size if chunk publication fails.
generatedTests: Existing generated ASCII/Binary ACIS carrier retained-budget controls verify Surface/Modeler payload bytes, chunk ranges, exact/under-cap admission, callback refusal, and same-facade retry.
Existing modeler text direct-append and writer chunk-boundary controls were rerun.
The owning DXF fixture CTest was rerun for proxy/opaque and ACIS DXF behavior.
